entities.summary: Tamara Gverdtsiteli (b. 1962-01-18, Tbilisi) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Tbilisi and Georgia. Known in the fields of georgia, poets & playwrights, asia.
